P25a1: Nobody can offer unlimited freedom, so the realistic standard is just that leaving shouldn't be made artificially impossible. Kids who grow up without ever using money especially need a decent education in how the money world operates, and what to do when they have to deal with it: jobs, rent, contracts, banks, scams, ID, getting around, and how to ask for help.

P28s2: The community has to share enough principles about raising kids to hang together, and still leave parents room to decide things for their own kids.
